newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ideal Pacific says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Ideal Pacific says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Sea freight transporter Ideal Pacific Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to buy an overseas freight forwarding business.

"There are negotiations between the company and independent third parties who are not connected persons of the company, in relation to the acquistion by the company of certain freight forwarding business in an overseas country," it said.
The company also said it had discussions with proposing vendors that the purchase might be satisfied by issuing shares.
Ideal Pacific said "no agreements have been signed and neither is there any binding agreement to enter into such agreements."
The company said it would make an announcement if the purchase was satisfied by shares of the company.
Its shares fell HK$0.04 to HK$1.49 in late morning.
